name: Hammered 30
notes: Peened metal: flat-toned polygonal dents, contrast between dents not within them, bright facet rims. Coverage is the damage dial: damage is a delta from the baseline material, and the level is how much of it there is. Dual-gate architecture (docs/fractal-texture-math.md par.9): the mask multiplies the finished stroke once, so its structure survives the paint train; canvas-anchored delivery was considered for the damage textures and rejected in review in favour of dual-gating everything. Tips synthesized and calibrated from tips/hammered.spec.json (levels 30/55/80 = core-band stroke coverage); spectral verification by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. First peening: scattered flat dents.
